pr_title: lightning: maintain task meta in singleTaskMetaMgr
pr_body:
<!--

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/34213

Problem Summary:

Lightning precheck doesn't check local disk resources and cluster available.

### What is changed and how it works?

When `incremental-import` is set to false, Lightning doesn't create a metadata schema in downstream TiDB. Instead, it creates a `singleTaskMetaMgr` to maintain task metadata. However, `singleTaskMetaMgr` always returns true for task existence check.


https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/9fc73ac219cbf65151fb9e8a41699c7b1d6cadef/br/pkg/lightning/restore/meta_manager.go#L1088

Precheck for local disk resources and cluster available are accidentally skipped. Because lightning thinks the check has been performed before. 
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/9fc73ac219cbf65151fb9e8a41699c7b1d6cadef/br/pkg/lightning/restore/restore.go#L1923

review_comments: seems changes in this file is not related to the fixing.

When checking cluster resource, `sourceBytes` need to read by `CheckTasksExclusively`.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/b7f26143e500379fec94c286badcac26bdfc90d6/br/pkg/lightning/restore/check_info.go#L127
I don't see any read from this field
It may be read and updated by `CheckTasksExclusively`.  Although there is no place to actually read it, adding it will avoid bugs caused by future changes.
